Benfica season|2017–18]] | nextseason = [[2019–20 S.L. Benfica season|2019–20]] }} The 2018–19 season was [[S.L. Benfica|Sport Lisboa e Benfica]]'s [[List of S.L. Benfica seasons|115th season]] in existence and the club's [[Primeira Liga#All-time Primeira Liga table|85th consecutive season]] in the top flight of [[Football in Portugal|Portuguese football]]. It started with the [[2018–19 UEFA Champions League qualifying phase and play-off round#League Path 3|UEFA Champions League third qualifying round]] on 7 August 2018 and concluded on 18 May 2019 with Benfica becoming [[2018–19 Primeira Liga|Primeira Liga champions]] for a record 37th time.{{cite news|date=18 May 2019|title=Benfica seal 37th Portuguese title|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/benfica-win-4-1-seal-37th-portuguese-title-201031579--sow.html|work=[[Yahoo Sports]]|access-date=25 May 2019}} Internationally, Benfica played in the [[2018–19 UEFA Champions League group stage|Champions League group stage]] for the ninth successive time, a Portuguese record ranking fourth all-time.{{cite news|date=29 August 2018|title=Só Real Madrid, Barcelona e Bayern têm mais presenças consecutivas na Champions|trans-title=Only Real Madrid, Barcelona and Bayern Munich have more consecutive appearances in the Champions|url=https://www.abola.pt/Clubes/Noticias/Ver/747469/40|url-status=dead|language=pt|work=A Bola|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180830011356/https://www.abola.pt/Clubes/Noticias/Ver/747469/40|archive-date=30 August 2018|access-date=30 August 2018}} However, with two losses at [[Estádio da Luz]], they set a domestic record of five consecutive home matches without a win in the competition.{{cite news|date=8 November 2018|title=Benfica bate recorde português de jogos consecutivos sem ganhar em casa|trans-title=Benfica beat Portuguese record of consecutive matches without winning at home|url=https://www.abola.pt/Clubes/Noticias/Ver/758402/40|url-status=dead|language=pt|work=A Bola|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181111172258/https://www.abola.pt/Clubes/Noticias/Ver/758402/40|archive-date=11 November 2018|access-date=11 November 2018}} After finishing third in their group, they moved to the [[2018–19 UEFA Europa League knockout phase|UEFA Europa League knockout phase]], where they reached the quarter-finals.
